title: Daande Gila e Yaasi
intro: Aɗa darii e wuro ɗo nelaaɓe tato ngari e maandeeji laaɓtuɗi, kono yimɓe ɓee ina njaltina ɓe, ina njokki e laabi maɓɓe ɓooyɗi. Gila e nokku ɓurɗo woɗɗude e wuro ngoo, limre ina doga ina ara e jamaanu nguu, ina foofa, ina felliti haalde goonga e yeeso jaɓgol. Hol oo ruuhu riisɗo kala ko woni e mesaas mo wonaa maɓɓe?
clues: Mi wuuriino e leñol ja66otoongol nulaaɓe e maandeeji laaɓɗi, tee ɓe mbayliima e mawnikinaare.
Mi wari mi doggi diga haa nokkure ɓurdunde woɗugo berniwol, mi nani noddaango nelaaɓe.
mbiy-mi leñol am, eeh leñol am ndewee e nulaaɓe. Rew e ɓe naamndaaki ma njoɓdi, sabu ko ɓe laaɓɓe.
Mi wonaano annabi, kono miɗo gooŋɗini nelaaɓe, miɗo ñaagii leñol am nde waɗata noon.
Leñol am ina ƴattoo wasiyaaji am, ina tuuma mi wonde ko mi ekstremist.
Nde 6e mbari kam, Alla wiyi mi yo mi naat Aljanna, micfo yicfi yim6e am ina ngannda yaafuya e teddungal ke6mi ngal.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Gooto e nelaaɓe tato nelaɓe e wuro ngoo

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Waajaade leñol mum yoo ndew nelaa6e
Mahde laana ngam hisnude goonɗinɓe e ilam
Wereede e nder yiite ngam goonɗinal
trial.answer: Waajaade leñol mum yoo ndew nelaa6e

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Feccere ɓurnde woɗɗude e wuro ngoo
location.answer: Feccere ɓurnde woɗɗude e wuro ngoo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Naati Aljanna, yiɗi yimɓe mum ngannda yaafuya mum
Njokkii e leñol mum sabu salaade nulal
Hisnaama e juuɗe Allah, heddiima e leñol mum
outcome.answer: Naati Aljanna, yiɗi yimɓe mum ngannda yaafuya mum

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
